title: Provider switch state types
responsibility: Defines pending provider switches, session observations and control interfaces, and derives a request revision marker.

inputs.name: switchRevision.record
inputs.description: A switch request in any declared status, or null when none exists. Only its id and status affect the revision marker.

examples.reason: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

outputs.name: desktopControlUnavailable
outputs.description: Fixed notice used when the desktop control connection is unavailable; it states that requests remain pending and provider settings do not change. Its text is constant.
examples: Desktop control connection unavailable. Requests stay pending; no provider settings change.

outputs.name: switchRevision
outputs.description: Returns the request id, a colon, and its status, or null when no request exists. It performs no validation or normalization.
